content:
**The publish guard asked AT instead of ON (#853)**

npm test went red on every maintainer checkout after the 1.4.0 release: the suite-level check asserted tag==HEAD, so the ordinary post-release state (main moved on) read as failure, with a message telling the operator to bump before a publish that had already happened. It was also INERT in CI — local-checks checks out without tags, so #852 passed green against the same red local suite. Narrowed to reachability via git merge-base --is-ancestor: moved-on passes, diverged still fails. The publish-time rule in publish.yml is untouched and its presence still pinned by the sibling test. Lesson: a guard that trains readers to ignore the suite has negative value — npm test's # fail 0 is this repo's pre-commit discipline.
